verdict.rationale: Portkey's docs describe a Logs section that lists every request processed through the gateway in order. Each log has a shareable URL and supports filtering and manual feedback. Separately, Portkey claims real-time tracking of 40+ metrics, including cost and latency, plus granular cost tracking. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that each log entry shows the full request/response payload with per-request latency, token counts, and cost attached, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the log view.
